cards.title: The rainforest canopy
cards.heroCaption: The canopy layer, seen from below

groups.title: What we can see
items: A thick layer of leaves and branches
Very little sunlight reaching the ground

groups.title: Why it matters
items: It shelters the layers below from heavy rain
It produces much of the oxygen we breathe
